summary: Mojang and Xbox Game Studios' sandbox franchise, covering the main Minecraft editions and standalone spinoffs.

entries.title: Minecraft

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC with Java mods/shaders and Bedrock cross-play

primary.why: On PC, Java Edition and Bedrock Edition are sold together through the unified launcher, giving Windows both the modding-focused Java route and the cross-platform Bedrock route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Java & Bedrock bundle on Windows through the Minecraft Launcher; use Java for mods/shaders and Bedrock for cross-platform play.

all_releases.fidelity: Java Edition on PC with mods, shaders, servers, and launcher access to Bedrock on Windows.
all_releases.reason: primary: Windows PC bundle gives the richest fidelity/modding route and Bedrock cross-play access.

all_releases.platform: Android / iOS / Xbox / PlayStation / Nintendo Switch / Fire OS / other Bedrock platforms
all_releases.reason: skip: excellent cross-platform route, but PC bundle includes Bedrock plus Java and has the highest archive ceiling.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Java has the strongest mod/shader ecosystem, while Bedrock has broad cross-platform play; the Windows bundle resolves the conflict by including both.

entries.remaster_caveats: No single edition is universally best for every server/mod/cross-play use case; the PC bundle is the archive recommendation.

entries.title: Minecraft: Story Mode
entries.definitive_edition: The Complete Adventure / complete owned episode set

emulation.notes: Use owned PC or console release.

primary.version: Complete Adventure / PC release if already owned
primary.why: Story Mode was a Telltale episodic adventure released across PC, console, and mobile, but digital availability is limited after delisting; PC Complete Adventure is the best archive route if already owned.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows Complete Adventure release if already owned, or use preserved physical console copies.

all_releases.platform: Windows / macOS / PlayStation / Xbox / Nintendo / Android / iOS / Apple TV / Netflix
all_releases.fidelity: Episodic adventure release across PC, consoles, mobile, and streaming.
all_releases.reason: primary: PC Complete Adventure is the preferred archive route when owned; otherwise physical console copies are preservation routes.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The complete PC route is ideal, but delisting and episode ownership make preserved physical/digital copies important.

entries.remaster_caveats: Digital delisting/ownership is the major caveat.

entries.title: Minecraft Earth

primary.why: Minecraft Earth was an AR mobile service title that shut down in 2021; the final service build is the authentic version.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route remains after service closure; preserve through archival documentation.

all_releases.reason: primary: only official platform family; service has shut down.

entries.remaster_caveats: Service closure prevents normal official play.

entries.title: Minecraft Dungeons

primary.why: Ultimate Edition includes the base game and all six DLCs; Windows is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Minecraft Dungeons Ultimate Edition on Windows/Steam or Microsoft Store.

all_releases.platform: Windows / Nintendo Switch / PlayStation 4 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S / Arcade
all_releases.fidelity: Dungeon crawler release with Ultimate Edition on PC and consoles plus arcade adaptation.
all_releases.reason: primary: Windows Ultimate Edition is the complete high-fidelity route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Ultimate Edition aligns content and fidelity on PC.

entries.remaster_caveats: Arcade adaptation is a separate amusement route, not the main full campaign route.

entries.title: Minecraft Legends

primary.why: Minecraft Legends shipped on PC and modern consoles; Windows/Steam or Microsoft Store is the highest-fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Minecraft Legends on Windows via Steam, Microsoft Store, or PC Game Pass.

all_releases.platform: Windows / Nintendo Switch / PlayStation 4 / PlayStation 5 / Xbox One / Xbox Series X/S / Xbox Cloud Gaming
all_releases.reason: primary: Windows has the highest configurable fidelity route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Development ceased after release updates; no later definitive edition identified.
